name: Weekly operating report review - safe sample

parameters.content:
# Calculate and review weekly operating metrics before sharing

## Who this is for
Operations teams, small-business owners, consultants, and n8n beginners who need a credential-free example of calculating weekly metrics while preserving exception review and final ownership.

## What it does
The workflow creates two fictional weekly records, normalizes the numbers, calculates request and completion rates, and makes missing ownership, overdue work, and critical exceptions visible. It routes a stable report to owner approval and an exception-bearing report to a review queue. It never publishes or sends a report.

## How to set it up
Run the sample as provided. Confirm that the stable record reaches `ready_for_owner_approval` with 5.6% request rate and 88.9% completion rate. Confirm that the second reaches `needs_exception_review` with 7.9% and 54.5% plus three clear reasons. No credentials are required.

## Requirements
n8n with the built-in Manual Trigger, Code, If, and Edit Fields nodes. All records and percentages are synthetic.

## How to customize
Replace only the fictional source after defining the reporting period, timezone, authoritative data source, late-data rule, owner, and stop conditions. Keep delivery disabled until a person compares the output with the source and approves it.
